versions.content: TransferData Type: valid Description: The Diagnostic Extract shall support the configuration of UDS service 0x36 (TransferData). Rationale: This service is used to actually execute a data transfer between client and server. Use Case: The user wants to transmit a piece of (mostly complex) data between client and server. Dependencies:  Supporting Material: More information about this diagnostic service can be found in the respective ISO specification [2].
